theorems.name: Submission.poincare_ball_double_integral_exhaustion
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Rn n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0∞), AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1)) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < 1 → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ∫⁻ y in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖f x - f y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ K) → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∫⁻ y in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖f x - f y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ K
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
